launches.title: The M6 MacBook Pro is probably the last of its kind
launches.excerpt: Apple has released the M6 MacBook Pro, serving as a straightforward chip upgrade to the entry-level lineup using the same chassis design as previous models. The device features a 12-core M6 processor and a new N1 networking chip that supports Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and Thread. Other hardware components remain consistent with earlier versions, including the 14.2-inch miniLED display, the large haptic trackpad, the keyboard, and the robust speaker system. The base model starts at $1,999 and includes 16GB of RAM alongside 1TB of storage, representing a higher price point compared to previous generations. Battery life remains exceptional, offering over 12 hours of continuous use during standard multitasking and video calls. While the M6 chip delivers strong performance for daily tasks, photo editing, and light gaming, the laptop faces a complicated market position due to upcoming OLED models and pricing overlaps with higher-tier configurations. Upgrading the RAM brings the cost close to more powerful Pro models, creating a difficult choice for buyers. The article notes that this release is likely the last pre-redesign MacBook Pro before Apple transitions its entry-level laptops to a thinner and lighter design featuring an OLED touchscreen. For consumers whose current computers still function well, waiting for the anticipated redesigned models next year may be a worthwhile option.

launches.title: Microsoft admits certifications can be a drag, launches creds that recognize skills
launches.excerpt: Microsoft has introduced a new credential type called the Pro Badge, which is designed to recognise skills demonstrated through everyday product use rather than traditional examinations. General manager for content and insights Cameron Percy acknowledged that people have long requested a simpler way to prove workplace skills without needing to prepare for separate tests. The company states that while traditional certifications show problem-solving abilities in a specific role, Pro Badges demonstrate how individuals use particular products during daily tasks. The first available credential of this type is for GitHub Copilot and is provided at no cost, requiring no separate exam or study guide. Users can earn the GitHub Pro Badge by signing in at the dedicated GitHub learning site, which activates a proficiency engine. This engine analyses relevant product usage signals and evaluates them against a defined framework to automatically update proficiency levels. launches.title: Amazon ECS Managed Daemons can now collect json-file logs from application containers on Amazon ECS Managed Instances
launches.excerpt: Amazon Elastic Container Service has introduced json-file log driver support for Amazon ECS Managed Instances alongside log driver volumes for Amazon ECS Managed Daemons. This combined functionality allows users to collect application logs using their preferred observability agent and forward them to any chosen destination. Application containers running on ECS Managed Instances can now write their logs as local files in the standard Docker json-file format, which is natively readable by most observability agents. Managed daemons can directly read these files through a volume mount without needing host bind mount paths or root privileges. Consequently, a single managed daemon on each instance can gather logs from every application container utilising the json-file log driver. geo.title: Russell Brand guilty of rape and sexual assault
geo.excerpt: Russell Brand has been found guilty of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault following a trial. The 51-year-old comedian and actor has been remanded in custody and is scheduled to be sentenced on Monday. The legal proceedings involved charges dating from 1999 to 2009. These allegations concerned a total of six women, all of whom are legally entitled to lifelong anonymity. BBC correspondent Sima Kotecha reported on how the trial unfolded in court. Further details regarding the specific testimonies or the jury's deliberations have not been immediately released. Brand's legal team has not yet commented publicly on the verdict. geo.title: Mother and daughter die after suspected grizzly bear attack in Canada
geo.excerpt: A mother and her daughter have died following a suspected grizzly bear attack in the Canadian province of British Columbia. Forty-eight-year-old Jennifer Balcarras and twenty-year-old Selah Reed were reported missing on the first of November after failing to return from a short afternoon walk. Their remains were discovered in a trail area in Bella Coola during search efforts conducted by the Royal Canadian Mounted Police and the BC Conservation Officer Service. Officials stated that evidence gathered at the scene indicated an animal may have been involved in the deaths. Conservation officers are currently working to track down any bears connected to the incident. According to the BC Conservation Officer Service, any captured animal found to have been involved will be dispatched in line with provincial human-wildlife conflict guidelines. Relatives described the victims as close companions who shared numerous hobbies and frequently hiked together. While conflicts between humans and grizzly bears are generally considered rare unless the animals are surprised or defending food and cubs, British Columbia has experienced several attacks in recent years. The BC Wildlife Federation has previously noted an increase in reported conflicts since the provincial government implemented a ban on sport hunting for grizzly bears in 2017.

geo.title: France holds new strikes and protests as unions demand immediate answers
geo.excerpt: Protests and strikes have taken place across France as five major trade unions launched a national day of action alongside high school students and demonstrators. By early afternoon, more than 250,000 people had gathered in nearly 70 towns and cities to demand higher wages, better public services, and relief from the rising cost of living. The demonstrations caused widespread disruption in schools, hospitals, and public transport, leading to the temporary closure of the Eiffel Tower and parts of the Louvre museum. Production was also halted at several oil refineries, and disruptions at nuclear plants meant France was expected to import more electricity than it produced. The government deployed 70,000 police officers to manage the demonstrations following sporadic unrest, with clashes reported between security forces and radical left-wing groups in cities including Lyon and Rennes. Union leaders are pressing for an increase in the minimum wage and a net monthly pay rise of 100 euros, while also calling for reforms to support workers and young people. In response to public pressure, ministers have released millions of barrels of diesel from strategic reserves to lower fuel costs and promised to reform the university admissions system by 2028. invest.title: Barkin sees interest rate hikes ahead, but at a gradual pace
invest.excerpt: Richmond Federal Reserve President Thomas Barkin stated on Thursday that the central bank will likely need to implement further interest rate increases, though the exact magnitude and speed remain undecided. Speaking during a CNBC interview at the Richmond Fed's 2026 CFO Summit, Barkin highlighted ongoing concerns regarding high inflation and near record low unemployment. He indicated that a gradual pace of policy adjustment is appropriate given current global uncertainty and the prospect of incoming economic data. These remarks follow a recent decision by his Federal Open Market Committee colleagues to maintain the benchmark overnight borrowing rate in a range between 3.75 percent and 4 percent. Although Barkin does not currently hold a vote on the rate-setting committee, he is scheduled to become a voting member in 2027. The FOMC previously noted that it is awaiting further information before determining its next steps, following a quarter percentage point hike in September. Barkin suggested that current monetary policy remains somewhat accommodative because consumption levels stay relatively elevated. He identified inflation as the most significant current risk, noting that artificial intelligence currently contributes to price pressures before it eventually boosts production and alleviates inflation in the future. Meanwhile, market pricing via the CME Group FedWatch tool indicates a probability exceeding 80 percent for a rate hike in December, followed by another move in 2027.
